detail.longDescription: A skill rated clean by every scanner can still tell your agent to do what your policy forbids. Taneja and Weber checked 66,192 ClawHub skill versions: 705 passed every scanner yet instruct actions barred by CIS Control 2.7 and NIST SP 800-53 CM-11. In a live sandbox, 34.7% of 144 commands carried consequences the skill docs never mention. Scanning asks "is it malicious?", not "is this action allowed here?" https:// arxiv.org/abs/2609.12001 # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # AI
